To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) for a fixed-length packetization video system, the optimal mode selection algorithm that minimizes distortion is to use intracoding if the channel is good, and use intercoding if the channel is bad, and (b) for a video coder operating over a time-varyng wireless Internet channel with delayed feedback information, it is better to use a refined distortion estimation method than a simple distortion estimation method for encoding.

the optimal intracoding/intercoding mode switcher, the efficient channel encoder, the re-synchronization scheme and the improved method of refined channel distortion estimation are all essential components of a robust video transmission system for a tandem channel with bit errors and packet erasures.

1) the optimal mode switching scheme is a combination of intracoding and predictive coding with re-synchronization, 2) the channel coding is an outer CRC concatenated with an inner punctured convolutional encoder, 3) the system is analyzed and simulated, and 4) the framework is extended for time-varying channels with feedback.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the efficient transmission of video over the Internet.
the efficient transmission of video over a packet-switched wireless Internet channel.
the design of a robust video coder that can operate on a packet-switch network with fixed-length packet and a time-varyng wireless Internet channel.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this dissertation has made a significant contribution in the area of packet video transmission over a tandem wireless channel.
the proposed scheme is an efficient and robust solution to the transmission of video over a tandem channel.
a robust scheme can be designed for packet video transmission over a tandem wireless channel, and that the proposed scheme is efficient in terms of both complexity and bandwidth.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proposed scheme provides good video quality with low bit rates and is robust to bit errors, packet erasures, and channel time variations.
the proposed algorithm for mode switching is optimal, and the proposed re-synchronization scheme is very robust.
the proposed system is robust to packet losses in both wired and wireless channels and that the proposed re-synchronization scheme is efficient in terms of bandwidth usage.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of feedback information in tandem channels can significantly enhance the video coding performance, especially when the channel is time varying and/or the feedback is delayed.
the proposed system can provide high-quality video over the Internet with low complexity.
, for a tandem channel with fixed-length packets, the best performance is achieved by using a hybrid scheme of intracoding and low-motion-compensated intercoding.
